svg.title: Poultry farmer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as poultry farmer, wearing coveralls and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Three separately outlined eggs sit above a shallow collection tray. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
